cost.question: How much does parcel delivery cost?
cost.answer: Next-day delivery is {nextDayBase} for the first {nextDayDistance}, then {nextDayPerKm} for each additional km. Same-day delivery is {sameDayBase} for the first {sameDayDistance}, then {sameDayPerKm} per km. Up to {includedWeight} is included; each extra kg adds {perKg}. You see the full price before you book.

difference.question: What is the difference between same-day and next-day delivery?
difference.answer: Same-day parcels are collected and delivered on the day you book. Next-day parcels are delivered the following day at a lower price.

range.question: How far can you deliver?
range.answer: We deliver within the UAE for trips of up to {distance} by road between pickup and delivery. For longer distances, contact our support team.

track.question: How do I track my shipment?
track.answer: Every shipment gets a short tracking ID of up to 8 characters. Enter it on the tracking page, or sign in to follow all your shipments and view proof of delivery.

cod.question: Can the driver collect payment from the recipient?
cod.answer: Yes. When booking, mark the parcel as postpaid (cash on delivery) and enter the amount to collect. The driver collects it from the recipient, separately from your delivery fee.

merchant.question: How do I open a merchant account?
merchant.answer: Create a free account, choose “Merchant” and submit your company details. Our team reviews every application; once approved you get flat-rate merchant pricing.

multiple.question: Can I send several parcels in one booking?
multiple.answer: Yes. Add as many shipments as you need to one booking — each can go to a different address — and pay for them together.
